title: Goofy Yell (Yaaah-hoo-hooey)
blurb: The Goofy yell — that unmistakable YAAAH-HOO-HOO-HOOEY of Disney's Goofy mid-catastrophe. It's been the official cartoon falling sound since the 1940s, and the meme era only expanded its jurisdiction: any person, object, or institution in freefall qualifies. Play it for stumbles, stock charts, and life plans leaving a cliff. A genuinely historic scream.
origin: Goofy's signature falling yell, a Disney sound tradition since the 1940s.
